question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: Emotion Detection in Text: Focusing on Latent Representation
answer_rationale: The document reports results on both the Wang et al. tweet dataset (which includes English tweets) and the CrowdFlower dataset (which is also in English, as it's annotated via crowd-sourcing for emotional labels and mapped to the same seven emotion categories). There is no mention of non-English datasets being used or results reported.
